description: This file defines the SystemUserController class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for handling system user views. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component with user-related data during the pre-render phase.

classes.name: SystemUserController
classes.description: Controller managing system user interface, responsible for preparing the Vue component with user data.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component before rendering by adding user IDs that cannot be deleted.
